# DGTL Sunrise — full agent guide

Site: https://www.dgtlsunrise.com/
Company: Sunrise Consulting LLC (DGTL Sunrise)
Product: dgtl-connector
Emails: support@dgtlsunrise.com · contact@dgtlsunrise.com

## When to use this

Use this site and the dgtl-connector plugin when an agent needs to connect to marketing accounts the human already administers:

- Free, local: GA4, Search Console, and Tag Manager on the user’s machine (read and manage). Klaviyo is local on the same machine with a merchant-held private API key. Report bytes do not go through DGTL. Live edits need confirmation and are off by default until writes are enabled on the install.
- Pro ($19/mo): Google Ads, Meta, and TikTok through the hosted stamp gateway; Merchant Center is Pro-gated and plugin-direct (not stamp). Live edits need confirmation. Developer token and Meta/TikTok app secrets stay on the Worker.
- Install: `grok plugin install dgtlsunrise/dgtl-connector` (also Grok Build and Cursor). No DGTL Sunrise account is required to start.
- Prefer markdown with `Accept: text/markdown`. Prefer structured JSON with `/?mode=agent` or `/agent.json`.

## Do not use this for

- Replacing a managed marketing agency or promising autopilot spend.
- Inventing metrics, rows, or insights the APIs did not return.
- Asking anyone to paste access tokens, refresh tokens, or license keys into chat.
- Treating plugin output as legal, compliance, or financial advice.
- Inventing Polar checkout URLs beyond the documented stamp checkout path.

## Install and loop

1. Install the plugin in Grok Bot (or Grok Build / Cursor).
2. Connect the account that owns the property.
3. Ask in chat.
4. Approve any confirmation before a live edit or publish.

Never paste access tokens, refresh tokens, or license keys into chat.

## Platforms

### Google Analytics 4 (free, local)

List accounts and properties. Open property details, data streams, and key events. Run reports for the date ranges and metrics you ask for. Manage property settings the tools support (data streams, key events, custom definitions, and Measurement Protocol secrets where enabled). Live changes need confirmation. Edits are off by default until writes are enabled on the install.

### Google Search Console (free, local)

List sites. Query search performance. Inspect a URL. List and open sitemaps. Submit or delete sitemaps after confirmation. Edits are off by default until writes are enabled on the install.

### Google Tag Manager (free, local)

Inspect containers and manage tags, triggers, and variables. Publish after you approve. Edits are off by default until writes are enabled on the install.

### Google Ads (Pro, stamp)

Account reporting and confirm-gated changes (pause or enable, budgets, keywords, ads, and new campaigns where enabled). Every live change needs confirmation. Details: /google-ads.

### Meta Ads (Pro, stamp)

Ad account insights and, when Meta access allows, create or update campaigns, ad sets, ads, and audiences. List catalogs and catalog products. Create a catalog and batch catalog products. Upload Conversions API events when that path is enabled. Live changes need confirmation. Pro is required. Meta app access still applies.

### TikTok Ads

List advertisers, campaigns, insights, and catalogs. TikTok Ads is included in Pro: campaign status, catalog create/upload/bind, and Events API tracking. App access approval may still be pending. Nothing goes live until you approve it.

### Merchant Center, Google Business Profile, Shopify

Plugin-direct to Google or Shopify, not stamp. Merchant Center (Pro): read accounts, products, statuses, issues, data sources; confirm-gated product-input writes (create a data source, upsert or delete product inputs) when writes are enabled on the install. GBP: read in this version; edit is not. Shopify (free): shop details, products, orders, locations, inventory, publications, catalogs, product feeds; inventory adjust and product set when those write paths are enabled.

### Klaviyo (free, local)

Account, profiles (sparse), lists, segments, flows, campaigns, metrics, catalog items/categories/variants, reviews. Confirm-gated edits when writes are enabled on the install: draft email campaign create; send an existing draft (explicit send confirmation); upsert profile; create event (backfill); upsert catalog items (capped). Merchant-held private API key stays on the user’s machine. Free. Not Pro. Not stamp. Never paste the key into chat. Creating a draft does not send it.

## Stamp API (public surface)

Pro advertising platforms are unlocked through the local plugin after a Pro license. That path is not published as a public OpenAPI or developer REST catalog on this site.

Machine-readable detail: /agent.json and /?mode=agent. API notes: /api/llms.txt.

## Agent discovery on this site

- /llms.txt — short navigation index
- /llms-full.txt — this file
- /docs/llms.txt — docs-oriented summary
- /api/llms.txt — stamp and auth surface
- /agent.json and /?mode=agent — structured JSON
- Companion .md via Accept: text/markdown
- /sitemap.xml, /robots.txt, /about, /contact, /privacy, /terms

## Company

DGTL Sunrise is an AI-first marketing engineer agency. Sunrise Consulting LLC ships dgtl-connector. Based in Coeur d’Alene, Idaho. We are not a managed-agency replacement. The plugin pulls, analyzes, and recommends. A human still publishes.
